plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
runtime: node 22; Stage A: CLI (ovhost); Stage B: express 4 + PostgreSQL 18 (openvibe-sdk/db, async) + Valkey 9 service
serviceManifestRegistered: host manifest v0.2.0 released (openvibe-contracts v0.24.0+), with the four host.* events

stages.A: alpha: ovhost CLI installed on the production host 2026-09-23 (/usr/local/bin/ovhost, inventory /etc/openvibe/host.json); every service deploys with `sudo ovhost deploy <svc>` since the 2026-09-27 cutover (roadmap WS-N task 11: Live, Tools, Sites, Games and OpenRestream through the release-layout, multi-app, static-build and pnpm-build strategies); nightly backups, restore drills (19 passed 2026-09-23, docs/restore-drills.md), release notifications, incidents and maintenance, the alerts relay; the D41 deploy-and-rollback proof (scripts/d41-proof.sh) is written and tested
stages.B: launched 2026-10-07 at openvibe.host (dashboard, API, front page) and *.openvibe.host (tenant sites); docs/launch.md, threat review in docs/threat-review.md
stages.C: not started (deliberately: blocked until isolation and metering are proven)

artifactStorage: local disk, content-addressed per project; HOST_OBJECT_STORE=media writes objects through to OpenVibe.Media with local disk as the read cache (opt-in, off by default)
capabilitiesNote: released in openvibe-contracts v0.24.0; v0.32.0 adds the four takedown routes to host.site.manage.implementedBy; v0.83.0 adds host.site.config; v0.107.0 adds the git-source routes and the planned host.resource.read (Host ships the resource index at GET /api/v1/resources and GET /api/v1/resources/:ovrn; OpenVibe.Contracts flips the capability to active, with the implementedBy routes, only after the deploy)
features: ovhost: inventory, validate, plan, deploy with automatic rollback, rollback, status, releases
deploy strategies: git-checkout, multi-app, static-build, pnpm-build, release-layout
certificate inventory and transactional nginx vhost install
scheduled PostgreSQL backup verification, logical dumps, retention and encrypted off-host copies
release notifications (host.release.published), incidents, maintenance windows and freezes
browser check and release-lifecycle acceptance suite
Stage B: tenant static sites with immutable deploys, activation, rollback, custom domains, quotas and takedowns

the authority resource index (ADR-048 section 3, plan T13 step 8): GET /api/v1/resources pages Host's sites (host.site, sit_), the immutable deploys of those sites (host.deploy, dpl_) and their default and custom domains (host.domain, dom_) as common.resource-summary@1, and GET /api/v1/resources/:ovrn reads one by its OVRN, for OpenVibe.Services' fan-out; guarded by the first-party host.resource.read, scoped by ?project= and paginated with an opaque cursor

Stage B git deploys, Phase 1: a site's Git source (repo + branch); the tenant's own CI posts each build, which lands as a source=git preview with immutable commit provenance and goes live only through activate (Host never clones, fetches, holds a credential or builds)
per-actor limits on Stage B writes (openvibe-sdk/limits)
